title: Toei Animation Produces New 'Ginga Tetsudou 999' Theatrical Anime Adaptation
content: Toei Animation announced a new theatrical anime adaptation for Ginga Tetsudou 999 ( Galaxy Express 999 ) anime franchise on Saturday. The new film features a story concept by Rintarou ( Ginga Tetsudou 999 (Movie) , Sayonara Ginga Tetsudou 999 director) and animation production by Toei Animation.
author: MyAnimeList

title: Anime Limited Licenses Banana Fish Anime
content: Netflix had announced earlier this month that it will stream the anime in "select regions" starting on August 12. Anime Limited confirmed the anime will be available on Netflix in the U.K., Ireland, the U.S., Canada, and France. Netflix 's stream will include English and French dubs.
author: ANN

title: Shintaro Kago's 'Blood Harvest' Short Story Manga Wins Eisner Award
content: The Will Eisner Comic Industry Awards announced the winners of this year's awards on Friday evening during San Diego Comic-Con 2026. Sanho's Purgatory Funeral Cakes won the Best U.S. Edition of International Material–Asia award. Dark Horse Comics published the work and Danny Lim translated the work.
author: ANN

title: Avatar: The Last Airbender’s Secret Project: Our 3 Best Predictions for What It Could Be
content: Avatar: The Last Airbender ‘s panel at San Diego Comic-Con was primarily focused on the release of the franchise’s Avatar Aang movie , as well as the looming Avatar: Seven Havens sequel series . With one releasing this weekend and the other coming out later this year, that’s really no surprise.

title: Ize Press Announces Print Licenses for Codename: Anastasia, Mignon BL Webtoons
content: Ize Press announced at its San Diego Comic-Con 2026 industry panel on Friday that it has licensed two boys-love webcomics, Codename: Anastasia and Mignon , for English print publication.

title: When Avatar Aang: The Last Airbender Releases on Paramount+
content: Avatar Aang: The Last Airbender debuts this weekend, with the first project out of Avatar Studios getting a limited theatrical run from July 24-30 and releasing on Paramount+ on July 25.
